name: map-first interactive: cartography runs, then the category taxonomy and plan are presented for user review before any deep-dive aspects
purpose: Verifies that with map-first accepted, cartography subagents run (>= 2 axes) and the orchestrator ends its turn presenting the tiered category taxonomy / coverage audit and proposed plan for feedback, without dispatching deep-dive aspect workers first.
prompt: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research skill, map-first mode. Answers to your Step 1 questions: yes to empirical field mapping; primary scope: academic cell-biology and bioinformatics methods research (NOT drug development); balanced report with explicit readiness tiers. Topic: categories of computational and experimental approaches for correcting batch effects in single-cell RNA-seq data. Proceed with cartography now, then present the category taxonomy and the proposed research plan for my review before any deep-dive research.

checks.desc: at least two cartography worker subagents dispatched (focus + context axes)
the final assistant message must present the category taxonomy/map
the final assistant message must invite plan feedback (taxonomy walk-through gate)
